old_caption: The video captures a sunrise over a mountainous landscape. The sky is a deep blue, gradually transitioning into lighter hues near the horizon where the sun is visible as a bright orb. Wispy clouds are scattered across the sky, illuminated by the soft light of the rising sun, casting a warm glow on their edges. The mountains in the foreground are dark and silhouetted against the brightening sky, creating a stark contrast. The clouds are moving, and the scene changes over time. The overall atmosphere is tranquil and peaceful, evoking a sense of calm and awe at the beauty of nature. There are no visible animals or characters in the scene, and the camera remains stationary throughout.
original_wisa_caption: The video captures a serene sunrise over a mountainous landscape. The sky is a deep blue, gradually transitioning into lighter hues near the horizon where the sun is just beginning to rise. Wispy clouds are scattered across the sky, illuminated by the soft light of the rising sun, casting a warm glow on their edges. The mountains in the foreground are dark and silhouetted against the brightening sky, creating a stark contrast. As the video progresses, the clouds continue to drift slowly, revealing more of the vibrant colors in the sky. The overall atmosphere is tranquil and peaceful, evoking a sense of calm and awe at the beauty of nature. There are no visible animals or characters in the scene, and the camera remains stationary throughout, allowing viewers to fully absorb the natural beauty unfolding before them.
caption: The video captures a steady dawn view over a layered mountain range, where a bright sun glow breaks through a low cloud bank on the left ridge while silhouetted peaks and a band of valley fog stay visually steady along the lower edge. Across the upper two-thirds, a deep blue sky is scattered with small altocumulus patches that grow denser toward the right. These cloud clusters drift slowly and subtly against the terrain. The long horizontal band above the sun and the right-side field inch across the view. In the central sky, a thin diagonal streak, like a high-altitude contrail, gradually strengthens from a faint trace into a defined line. The warm halo around the sun and the overall sky brightness hold roughly steady, so no full sunrise progression or cloud dissipation is evident. The scene unfolds as an ongoing gentle drift over the horizon.

endpoints are normal, not physical errors. Do not add unseen causes, onset, stopping or outcomes.
An internal editing cut is not evidence of physical motion connecting the views.

Check identification before physical interpretation: a reflection is not a separate actor;
a powder/smoke/liquid outline or shadow is not automatically the boundary of a solid object;
an apparent change caused by occlusion/viewpoint is not automatically material deformation.
Do not claim contact, bending, compression, melting, disintegration or structural recovery unless
the appropriate material/surface itself provides visible evidence. Do not infer a force or earlier
collision just because the visible configuration would be compatible with it.
Compare several frames before asserting translation, rotation, direction, unchanged position or
camera tracking. A single visible texture/seam does not prove spin. Avoid unnecessary absolute
claims of stillness, no motion, no camera motion or 'exactly' synchronized changes.
Remove invented scene details and explanations, but keep clearly visible ongoing motion and
processes. Avoid deleting the real process merely because its cause lies outside the cropped window.

provided original word count within 85%-115%, using genuinely visible details and process.

This is a direct video description, not an analysis note. No mandatory beginning/end formula.
Complete every sentence. If accuracy requires a substantial length difference, explain it outside
